description: This file contains asynchronous database access functions for managing audit logs, including creating new logs and listing logs globally or for specific entities.

methods.name: AuditLog create_audit_log(session: AsyncSession, payload: AuditLogCreate)

methods.name: List[AuditLog] list_audit_logs(session: AsyncSession, limit: int = 100)

methods.name: List[AuditLog] list_audit_logs_for_entity( session: AsyncSession, entity_type: str, entity_id: str, limit: int = 100 )
methods.description: Retrieves recent audit logs for a specific entity type and ID.
